messages.text: Donald ends retirement to make dramatic Rams return

metadata.summary: Aaron Donald has officially come out of retirement and will return for the Los Angeles Rams this season.
metadata.content: Aaron Donald: Los Angeles Rams legendary defensive tackle comes out of retirement for 2026 season | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to content Aaron Donald: Los Angeles Rams legendary defensive tackle comes out of retirement for 2026 season Aaron Donald has agreed a one-year deal with the Rams after two and a half years in retirement; the 35-year-old joins a defensive line where he and Myles Garrett hold five of the last nine Defensive Player of the Year awards between them Sunday 30 August 2026 21:53, UK Image: Aaron Donald celebrates the Los Angeles Rams' Super Bowl win in the 2021 season Aaron Donald has officially come out of retirement and will return for the Los Angeles Rams this season. The 35-year-old is coming back after two and a half years away from the game to form a defensive pairing with Myles Garrett that will alarm every offensive line in the NFL. The Rams confirmed Donald's decision on Sunday at the end of weeks of talks and almost two months of workouts at the club's facility, where Donald tested whether his body could stand another season. He has signed a one-year contract, with ESPN reporting the deal is worth at least $20m and built heavily on incentives. metadata.content: Kobbie Mainoo stars alongside Bruno Fernandes in Man Utd's win over Ipswich - Premier League hits and misses | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Kobbie Mainoo stars alongside Bruno Fernandes in Man Utd's win over Ipswich - Premier League hits and misses The Sky Sports football writers analyse Sunday's Premier League action as Kobbie Mainoo also impresses for Man Utd. Plus: Chelsea beat Brighton in thriller but is low possession a problem for Xabi Alonso's side? Sunderland sees off Fulham; Leeds and Brentford show growth... Sunday 30 August 2026 20:32, UK Image: Kobbie Mainoo impressed for Manchester United against Ipswich Town Bruno stars but Mainoo impresses too Bruno Fernandes produced yet another match-winning performance for Manchester United in their come-from-behind 5-2 win over Ipswich. The Premier League assist king could not depart without throwing one of those in too for United's fifth at Old Trafford. "I understand Bruno will be getting a lot of the credit but [Kobbie Mainoo] was immense," said Michael Carrick afterwards. Fernandes was indeed the player of the match, but it was the performance of Mainoo against Ipswich that was most encouraging for United. messages.text: Nordqvist bids emotional farewell to playing career ahead of Solheim Cup captaincy

metadata.summary: Anna Nordqvist brought an emotional end to her 18-year playing career at the FM Championship on Sunday, 12 days before she leads Team Europe into the Solheim Cup as captain, live on Sky Sports.
metadata.content: Anna Nordqvist: Team Europe's Solheim Cup captain bids emotional farewell to playing career at LPGA Tour's FM Championship | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to content Update Anna Nordqvist: Team Europe's Solheim Cup captain bids emotional farewell to playing career at LPGA Tour's FM Championship Anna Nordqvist's playing career ended at the FM Championship on Sunday, 12 days before she captains Team Europe at the Solheim Cup; Ruoning Yin of China ended a two-year wait for a win on the LPGA Tour; watch the Solheim Cup live on Sky Sports Golf from September 11-13 Stuart Hodge @Hodgeythehack Sunday 30 August 2026 21:48, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Solheim Cup captain Anna Nordqvist played her final round on the LPGA Tour at the FM Championship Anna Nordqvist brought an emotional end to her 18-year playing career at the FM Championship on Sunday, 12 days before she leads Team Europe into the Solheim Cup as captain, live on Sky Sports . The 39-year-old, who announced this week that Boston would be her farewell, finished on the ninth green at TPC Boston surrounded by fellow players and caddies, signing off with a level-par final round to finish one under for the week. Her career ends with 16 victories, including three majors, 19 top-10 finishes in major championships and five Solheim Cup triumphs from nine consecutive appearances.
